synopsis.text:
Mini episodes for the Girls und Panzer: Motto Love Love Sakusen desu! series bundled with the Blu-ray release.

Note: The first two episodes were initially shown alongside the theatrical pre-screening of Girls und Panzer: Motto Love Love Sakusen desu! movies 1 and 3.
